source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to each store to build Accessibility checklist using the information gathered from Survey Monkey form.
3. Go back to their respective store/location, fill in the blank to complete the
   checklist by manually verifying.
4. Take pictures using Android phone camera to include detailed information as a
   proof (e.g. the ramp is not up to code because its angle is more than 45°).
5. Upload pictures into the "Inspection-photos/accessibility" folder in the cloud.
6. Send the integrity check form to the client asking to manually verify the
   answers included in the building accessibility checklists.
